messages:
sophie_cs: FYI — PelotonHealth (enterprise customer) opened a ticket: rerank precision dropped ~18% after our model swap earlier this week. samples & expected labels attached to the ticket. @oliver_pm can you triage? :flushed:

oliver_pm: thanks Sophie. can you paste a minimal repro (1-2 queries + expected order) here so we can sanity-check quickly?

sophie_cs: pasted three queries from their support ticket below with top-5 results from our API and the expected order. Example: Query: "latest immunization record". Our API top result is a general billing doc, expected was the immunization table entry. full snippets in the ticket.

rajiv_ml: looking through the notes. we pushed rwd/llama2-70-q4-2026-03-04 to rerank routes last week. did PelotonHealth get the q4 variant? @tan_se can you confirm routing?

tan_se: PelotonHealth is on Dedicated, pinned route shows model-id=rwd/llama2-70-q4-2026-03-04. routing logs: https://console.redwood/logs/route/CS-8421 — 98% q4 for the last 5k requests.

rajiv_ml: possible quantization precision loss. need to run their eval set against fp16 baseline and q4 to measure delta. Sophie, can you attach their labeled eval set to the ticket?

sophie_cs: uploaded eval set to the ticket (CS-8421). link: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/CS-8421/files and pasted a couple of labelled examples here.

simon_peloton: experiencing degraded UX; users often get non-actionable results. not catastrophic but they said they'd consider pausing new ingests if unresolved. asking for rollback asap if that's the fast path.

oliver_pm: proposed plan: short-term — rollback this customer's dedicated route to fp16 variant; medium — run ablation to confirm culprit; long-term — add customer-eval gating on dedicated rollouts. acceptance criteria: <1% precision delta on customer eval set before full rollout.

rajiv_ml: I can run the batch eval tonight (2hr run). if q4 is culprit, we should either revert or add automatic fallback to fp16 for failing customer evals. I'll also try q8 and alternative quant configs.

tan_se: rollback needs deploy window approval. @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary rollback for route CS-8421? we prefer off-peak 02:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollback canary for route CS-8421 at 2026-03-08T02:00Z. auto-monitoring will validate latency & error rates for 4h post-rollback.

oliver_pm: Sophie please update PelotonHealth with the rollback plan and timeline: initial canary 4-6h, full rollback and 24h monitoring. set expectation for RCA in 48h.

sophie_cs: will update ticket and notify customer. marking P1 due to potential business impact. :pray:

rajiv_ml: Eval results in — preliminary numbers: q4 shows ~17% drop in precision@5 vs fp16 on their labeled set (CSV attached to CS ticket). also saw some reordering patterns around certain entity types (dates, meds).

oliver_pm: given that, proceed with the rollback once canary window opens. add a product hotfix: 'rerank-precision-regression — investigate quantization impact and add canary gating'. I'll create a sprint card PRD-regen-942 and link ticket. acceptance: ablation + either improved quant profile or enforced customer gating.

tan_se: note — rollback to fp16 raises infrastructure costs slightly and may increase 95th percentile latency by ~30ms in worst cases; we'll monitor.

sophie_cs: told customer we will rollback to their previous model and follow-up with RCA + timeline. they acknowledged and prefer rollback. updating CS-8421 now.

rajiv_ml: rollback canary executed, monitoring shows rerank precision on Peloton eval set back within 0.8% of baseline. attaching post-canary metrics.

oliver_pm: great. close the immediate customer issue. action items: (1) rajiv run deeper ablation (q8 vs q4 vs fp16), (2) product to add customer-eval acceptance test for dedicated rollout, (3) devex to add a pre-rollout checklist to avoid surprises. I'll own the product card.

sophie_cs: customer confirms improvement and is satisfied for now. leaving ticket open for RCA and postmortem. thanks all. :white_check_mark:

rajiv_ml: postmortem notes I'll add: reproduce locally with their eval set, quantify token-level differences, and add quantization regression tests to model onboarding pipeline.

oliver_pm: locking this thread into the product triage board and adding retro notes to release checklist. cc: @tan_se for rollback cost numbers.

sophie_cs: closing loop with customer and scheduling 48h follow-up. thanks team.
